items.text: Tampa Bay QB: Baker Mayfield (foot/ankle, in and out of a walking boot over the bye) is uncertain; not considered long-term, IR not considered. Rookie Jalon Daniels would start if he can't. Team signed Easton Stick to the active roster. Game-time decision possible.
Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Tampa Bay: QUESTIONABLE - S Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle). IR - WR Jalen McMillan, LB Christian Rozeboom, CB Josh Hayes.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Detroit: DE Aidan Hutchinson tore his ACL vs NE and is out for the season. OUT last week - S Kerby Joseph (knee), CB D.J. Reed, C Cade Mays. IR - LB Jack Campbell, LB Devin White, G Ben Bartch, RB Isiah Pacheco. Jared Goff starts.

adjust.reason: Detroit has lost DE Aidan Hutchinson for the season on top of S Kerby Joseph, CB D.J. Reed, C Cade Mays and LB Jack Campbell, while Tampa Bay's non-QB absences are lighter. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
